sanitizer.expanded_semantics: return the u16 species only when species < 4096 and ExpandedSpeciesV1.flags.defined is set; otherwise return SPECIES_NONE

compatibility.policy: 412..439 remain undefined in ExpandedSpeciesV1 until explicit Egg/Unown compatibility mapping is implemented; the sanitizer therefore rejects them exactly as the original SanitizeSpecies did
compatibility.future_species: new logical IDs become valid by installing a defined ExpandedSpeciesV1 record; no global NUM_SPECIES bump is required for this sanitizer

remaining_runtime_bounds: other NUM_SPECIES/SPECIES_EGG graphical and UI bounds
